cand.title: CEO Summit by Ignite 2026
cand.excerpt: Strong event evidence and clear Guadalajara demand mechanism; accessibility is discounted where the venue or incumbent hotel is confirmed.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Luis Aguirre, CEO and co-founder of Ignite and named Summit organizer, is the senior relationship route. Juan Diego González, Commercial and Innovation Lead, is an event-page commercial contact. José Luis Font, Ignite partner leading business experiences/events and KOVA co-founder, is an additional relevant intermediary. None is publicly established as the hotel-contract signatory.
findings.futureEdition: No announced Guadalajara edition after 14 November 2026 through May 2028 was located in the reviewed organizer and partner materials. The verified main forum was 5 November 2026, not its brochure upload date or news publication date. Post-event reporting confirms it took place. A 2027 repeat is an inference from prior editions, not a confirmed edition.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel profile: the 216-room, full-service Sheraton could pursue a right-sized portion of future visiting executive/speaker accommodation and associated meetings, if the buyer confirms demand. International/national participation and the reported 4–6 November 2026 ancillary programme support a travel mechanism, not a room forecast. City-hotel positioning fits this urban executive programme better than a resort proposition. Expo adjacency is not an evidenced advantage for a forum repeatedly held at Hilton Midtown; no Expo Guadalajara linkage or Sheraton function-space capacity is verified.
findings.venueCommitments: Hotel Hilton Guadalajara Midtown was the published and reported actual 2026 forum venue. This establishes an incumbent competing hotel for that edition, not a disclosed accommodation contract or future exclusivity. No future-edition venue commitment verified.
findings.historicalRotation: Guadalajara/Hilton Guadalajara Midtown appears in 2024 (7 November), 2025 (6 November), and 2026 (5 November). No destination or venue rotation is demonstrated by these three editions. Edition numbering conflicts: 2024 press calls it the fourth edition, while 2025 reporting says second and 2026 organizer materials say third; do not reconcile these by assumption.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Hotel sourcing status: unknown/unconfirmed for any future edition; the 2026 meeting venue is historical and committed elsewhere. No published room block, room-night count, booking link, group rate, lodging RFP, procurement deadline, or accommodation buyer mandate was located. Approach Ignite directly; Kova Group/Beyond Hospitality is a sourced event collaborator, not a verified lodging procurement agent.
findings.organizationStructure: Ignite Commercial Strategy describes itself as a commercial-strategy consultancy, not an association. Ignite organizes the Mexico Summit; Huete&Co and Adizes Institute are founding partners; Deloitte presented the 2026 edition. Kova Group and Beyond Hospitality collaborated. This is an executive business forum, not primarily a sports/entertainment event; Charros baseball was an ancillary experience.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The same competing hotel appears across three editions. That is an incumbent relationship signal, not proof of exclusivity. The organizer announced 300 confirmed attendees and an admission waitlist before the 2026 event; this is event-seat capacity, not evidence of sold-out hotel rooms or overflow. No accommodation displacement or overflow requirement verified.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Juan Diego González, copying Luis Aguirre, for a post-event review and next-cycle planning discussion. Ask whether a 2027 or January–May 2028 Guadalajara edition is approved, who controls hotel and accommodation selection, when proposals are considered, and whether Hilton has renewal/exclusivity rights. Request actual out-of-town attendance, room pickup and stay pattern before pricing. Ask whether José Luis Font/Kova handles any travel or lodging. Offer a Sheraton inspection and a conditional meetings/guestroom proposal only after dates, capacity and sourcing accessibility are established; do not create a speculative room block.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: Closed by elapsed event dates: the main forum occurred 5 November 2026 and the reported broader experience ran 4–6 November. Neither remains sellable on 14 November 2026. Do not present 2026 dates, sponsorship offers, invitation waitlists, or Hilton commitments as a current open hotel opportunity.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Conditional relationship-development opportunity only. Multiple editions support recurrence, but do not establish a 2027 date, open sourcing, destination change or renewed Hilton contract. Seek permission to compete before the next selection cycle; consider lodging-only or speaker accommodation only if a genuine need is confirmed.

cibMappingHints.whyThisHotel: Inference from the supplied product: a full-service city hotel can serve visiting executives, but Expo proximity is not a demonstrated demand driver for this Midtown-based event.
cibMappingHints.whatIsHappening: The 2026 executive business forum took place on 5 November at Hilton Guadalajara Midtown; it is historical, not upcoming.
cibMappingHints.potentialBusiness: Unquantified, conditional future executive/speaker rooms and meetings; no published room demand or open sourcing.
cibMappingHints.recommendedNextStep: Post-event buyer conversation to establish next-cycle approval and hotel-selection accessibility before submitting a proposal.

supportingSources.claim: Actual 2026 forum date, venue, agenda and public organizer contacts.
2026 forum took place; post-event report dated 5 November 2026.
Ignite is a consultancy; staff roles include Juan Diego González and José Luis Font.
Luis Aguirre is Summit organizer; José Luis Font has Kova/Beyond Hospitality roles.
Organizer announced 300 confirmed attendees, an admission waitlist and founding partners; not a room block.
Brochure contains 280-attendee figures, historical coverage, sponsorship offers and mixed-year text; not evidence of room demand.
2025 actual event date 6 November and Hilton venue.
2024 scheduled event date 7 November and Hilton venue; edition-number conflict.
2024 post-event account confirms Hilton venue and reports 150 attendees.
2026 ancillary programme reported for 4–6 November; Kova/Beyond collaborators.

suggestedOrsFollowUps: Keep 2026 out of the live upcoming-opportunity pipeline; retain the organizer as a historical relationship-development account pending final qualification.
Ask the two verified Ignite contacts to resolve next-edition approval, dates, procurement responsibility, incumbent terms and actual accommodation demand.
If a future edition is confirmed, validate Sheraton meeting layouts, executive service requirements and transport suitability before advancing qualification.
remainingUncertainties: Whether another Guadalajara edition is approved within the remaining horizon; its dates, venue and selection timetable.
Whether Hilton has any future renewal or exclusivity arrangement; no contract terms were public in reviewed sources.
Who signs hotel contracts and whether Ignite, Kova/Beyond Hospitality, delegates or another agency books accommodation.
Actual overnight delegates, room nights, peak rooms, stay length and hotel pickup; event attendance is not room demand.
Conflicting edition numbering and mixed-year brochure content; the partner landing page also mixes Guadalajara details with Madrid programme text.
structured.commercialOpportunityTrack: Do not qualify the expired 2026 edition as upcoming business. Retain only for historical relationship development and conditional future competitive capture; no 2027–May 2028 edition verified.
